title: Act: Rebuild ContributionSheet on the Dialog parts
summary: Wrap ContributionSheet markup in Dialog with title and description
description: Replace the div role=dialog in ContributionSheet.tsx with Dialog, DialogContent, DialogTitle and DialogDescription.
acceptance_criteria: Escape and overlay dismissal call onClose via onOpenChange
Title and description are Radix Title and Description
technical_constraints: Hooks stay above any conditional return

steps.action: Add import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogTitle } from './ui/dialog'.
steps.code: import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogTitle } from './ui/dialog';

steps.action: Delete the early return null for !open. Replace the outer div with <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={(next) => { if (!next) onClose(); }}><DialogContent className="contribution-sheet">. Replace the h2 with <DialogTitle>Suggest What Happens Next</DialogTitle> and the closing-note p with <DialogDescription>Ideas are considered when the Round closes.</DialogDescription>. Keep the remaining-count p, form, alert, list and Close button unchanged inside DialogContent, then close the tags.
steps.expected: open=false renders no dialog; open=true renders role=dialog named Suggest What Happens Next
